541	-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
542	-- 7a. Template immutability guard
543	-- Reject section/content changes if any submission references this
544	-- template at the current version. Studio must bump version instead.
545	-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
546	
547	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_consent_template_immutability()
548	RETURNS TRIGGER
549	LANGUAGE plpgsql
550	SECURITY DEFINER
551	SET search_path = public
552	AS $$
553	BEGIN
554	  -- Only applies when sections or name changed
555	  IF OLD.sections IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.sections
556	    OR OLD.name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.name
557	    OR OLD.kind IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kind
558	    OR OLD.language IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.language
559	    OR OLD.requires_guardian IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.requires_guardian
560	    OR OLD.retention_years IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.retention_years
561	  THEN
562	    -- Check if any submission references this template at this version
563	    IF EXISTS (
564	      SELECT 1
565	        FROM public.consent_form_submissions
566	       WHERE template_id = OLD.id
567	         AND template_version = OLD.version
568	       LIMIT 1
569	    ) THEN
570	      RAISE EXCEPTION
571	        'consent_template_immutable: template % version % has signed submissions. Create a new version row instead of modifying existing content.',
572	        OLD.id, OLD.version
573	        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
574	    END IF;
575	  END IF;
576	  RETURN NEW;
577	END;
578	$$;

614	-- 7c. Compute audit_hash — SECURITY DEFINER helper
615	-- Called from submit_consent_form RPC (not a trigger — avoids
616	-- chicken-and-egg on NEW.id not yet existing before INSERT).
617	-- Exposed as a standalone function so it can also be used for
618	-- verification at read time.
619	-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
620	
621	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_consent_audit_hash(
622	  p_submission_id   uuid,
623	  p_template_snapshot jsonb,
624	  p_answers         jsonb,
625	  p_signature_path  text,
626	  p_signer_name     text,
627	  p_signed_at       timestamptz
628	)
629	RETURNS text
630	LANGUAGE sql
631	SECURITY DEFINER
632	STABLE
633	SET search_path = public
634	AS $$
635	  SELECT encode(
636	    digest(
637	      p_template_snapshot::text
638	        || p_answers::text
639	        || p_signature_path
640	        || p_signer_name
641	        || p_signed_at::text,
642	      'sha256'
643	    ),
644	    'hex'
645	  );
646	$$;

648	-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
649	-- 7d. Post-INSERT trigger on consent_form_submissions
650	-- Responsibilities:
651	--   1. Compute and write audit_hash
652	--   2. Set expires_at from template.retention_years
653	--   3. If booking_id present, update bookings.consent_submission_id + consent_signed_at
654	--   4. Insert audit_log entry
655	-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
656	
657	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_consent_submission_post_insert()
658	RETURNS TRIGGER
659	LANGUAGE plpgsql
660	SECURITY DEFINER
661	SET search_path = public
662	AS $$
663	DECLARE
664	  v_retention_years int;
665	  v_hash            text;
666	BEGIN
667	  -- 1. Fetch template retention_years
668	  SELECT retention_years
669	    INTO v_retention_years
670	    FROM public.consent_form_templates
671	   WHERE id = NEW.template_id;
672	
673	  -- 2. Compute audit hash
674	  v_hash := public.compute_consent_audit_hash(
675	    NEW.id,
676	    NEW.template_snapshot,
677	    NEW.answers,
678	    NEW.signature_path,
679	    NEW.signer_name,
680	    NEW.signed_at
681	  );
682	
683	  -- 3. Write audit_hash and expires_at back to the row
684	  UPDATE public.consent_form_submissions
685	     SET audit_hash = v_hash,
686	         expires_at = NEW.signed_at + (COALESCE(v_retention_years, 7) * interval '1 year')
687	   WHERE id = NEW.id;
688	
689	  -- 4. Update booking consent linkage if booking_id supplied
690	  IF NEW.booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN
691	    UPDATE public.bookings
692	       SET consent_submission_id = NEW.id,
693	           consent_signed_at     = now()
694	     WHERE id = NEW.booking_id
695	       AND studio_id = NEW.studio_id;
696	  END IF;
697	
698	  -- 5. Audit log entry (service-role bypass — no INSERT policy for authed role)
699	  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
700	    action,
701	    target_type,
702	    target_id,
703	    studio_id,
704	    details
705	  ) VALUES (
706	    'consent.signed',
707	    'consent_form_submissions',
708	    NEW.id::text,
709	    NEW.studio_id,
710	    jsonb_build_object(
711	      'template_id',      NEW.template_id,
712	      'template_version', NEW.template_version,
713	      'client_id',        NEW.client_id,
714	      'signer_name',      NEW.signer_name,
715	      'booking_id',       NEW.booking_id
716	    )
717	  );
718	
719	  RETURN NEW;
720	END;
721	$$;

787	-- Anon-safe via token. Returns request + template + minimal client/booking info.
788	-- Flips status from 'pending' to 'opened' on first access (opened_at IS NULL).
789	-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
790	
791	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_consent_request(
792	  p_token uuid
793	)
794	RETURNS jsonb
795	LANGUAGE plpgsql
796	SECURITY DEFINER
797	SET search_path = public
798	AS $$
799	DECLARE
800	  v_req    record;
801	  v_result jsonb;
802	BEGIN
803	  SELECT
804	    cfr.id              AS req_id,
805	    cfr.studio_id       AS req_studio_id,
806	    cfr.template_id     AS req_template_id,
807	    cfr.booking_id      AS req_booking_id,
808	    cfr.client_id       AS req_client_id,
809	    cfr.status          AS req_status,
810	    cfr.expires_at      AS req_expires_at,
811	    cfr.opened_at       AS req_opened_at
812	  INTO v_req
813	  FROM public.consent_form_requests cfr
814	  WHERE cfr.request_token = p_token;
815	
816	  IF v_req.req_id IS NULL THEN
817	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'request_not_found');
818	  END IF;
819	
820	  IF v_req.req_status = 'signed' THEN
821	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'already_signed');
822	  END IF;
823	
824	  IF v_req.req_status = 'cancelled' THEN
825	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'request_cancelled');
826	  END IF;
827

908	  p_signer_name          text,

1001	    p_signer_name,

58	  if (!success) {

60	  }
61	
62	  let rawBody: unknown
63	  try {
64	    rawBody = await request.json()
65	  } catch {

67	  }
68	
69	  const parsed = SubmitBodySchema.safeParse(rawBody)
70	  if (!parsed.success) {
71	    return Response.json({ error: 'validation_error', details: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
72	  }
73	
74	  const body = parsed.data
75	
76	  // Validate main signature PNG
77	  const sigValidation = validateSignatureBase64(body.signature_png_base64, 'signature')
78	  if (!sigValidation.valid || !sigValidation.buffer) {
79	    return Response.json({ error: sigValidation.error }, { status: 400 })
80	  }
81	
82	  // Validate guardian signature if present
83	  let guardianBuffer: Buffer | undefined
84	  if (body.guardian?.signature_png_base64) {
85	    const gValidation = validateSignatureBase64(body.guardian.signature_png_base64, 'guardian_signature')
86	    if (!gValidation.valid || !gValidation.buffer) {
87	      return Response.json({ error: gValidation.error }, { status: 400 })
88	    }

90	  }
91	
92	  const supabase = createPublicClient()
93	  const serviceRole = createServiceRoleClient()
94	
95	  // Call submit_consent_form RPC
96	  const { data: rpcResult, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('submit_consent_form', {
97	    p_request_token: body.request_token,
98	    p_answers: body.answers as unknown as Json,
99	    p_signature_png_base64: body.signature_png_base64,

117	  }

119	  const result = rpcResult as Record<string, unknown>
120	  if (result['error']) {
121	    const httpStatus =
122	      result['error'] === 'already_signed' ? 409
123	      : result['error'] === 'expired' ? 410
124	      : result['error'] === 'request_cancelled' ? 410
125	      : result['error'] === 'request_not_found' ? 404
126	      : 500
127	    return Response.json(rpcResult, { status: httpStatus })
128	  }

131	  const guardianPath = result['guardian_path'] as string | null | undefined
132	  const submissionId = result['submission_id'] as string
133	  const studioId = signaturePath.split('/')[0] ?? ''  // path: {studio_id}/{submission_id}/signature.png
134	
135	  // Upload signature PNG to storage
136	  try {
137	    await uploadSignaturePng(serviceRole, sigValidation.buffer, signaturePath)
138	  } catch (err) {
139	    logger.error({ err, signaturePath, submissionId }, 'signature upload failed')
140	    return Response.json({ error: 'submission_failed' }, { status: 500 })
141	  }
142	
143	  // Upload guardian PNG if present
144	  if (guardianBuffer && guardianPath) {
145	    try {
146	      await uploadSignaturePng(serviceRole, guardianBuffer, guardianPath)

148	      logger.error({ err, guardianPath, submissionId }, 'guardian signature upload failed')

3	/**
4	 * Extract the real client IP from a Next.js request.
5	 *
6	 * Priority:
7	 *  1. cf-connecting-ip  — Cloudflare's source-of-truth header (not spoofable past CF)
8	 *  2. x-forwarded-for[0] — first (leftmost) IP; this is the client IP as seen by the
9	 *     first proxy. On Railway + Cloudflare the chain is: client, CF-edge, Railway-edge.
10	 *     The leftmost value is the original client IP.
11	 *  3. x-real-ip         — set by some reverse proxies as a single-value shorthand
12	 *  4. 'anon'            — fallback when no headers are present (local dev)
13	 *
14	 * Note: x-forwarded-for is spoofable if the client sends their own header before
15	 * hitting Cloudflare. Prefer cf-connecting-ip on CF-proxied deployments.
16	 */
17	export function getClientIp(req: NextRequest): string {
18	  const cf = req.headers.get('cf-connecting-ip')
19	  if (cf) return cf.trim()
20	
21	  const xff = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')
22	  if (xff) return xff.split(',')[0]!.trim()
23	
24	  const xri = req.headers.get('x-real-ip')
25	  if (xri) return xri.trim()
26	
27	  return 'anon'
28	}
